name: atc-codestudio
description: ATC CodeStudio graphical programming desktop application
author: Openblock.cc Team <contact@openblock.cc> (http://www.openblock.cc/)

scripts.i18n:src: mkdirp translations/core && format-message extract --out-file translations/core/en.json src/main/**.js
scripts.build:dev: npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dev
scripts.build:dir: npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dir
scripts.build:dist: npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dist
scripts.build:publish: npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=publish
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=dist
scripts.publish: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run doBuild -- --mode=publish
scripts.test:est: node scripts/test-est-protocol.js && node scripts/test-est-hardware-refresh.js && node scripts/test-est-hardware-selection.js && node scripts/test-est-vision.js && node scripts/test-est-holistic.js && node scripts/test-est-independent-vision.js && node scripts/test-est-camera-i18n.js && node scripts/test-est-python-generation.js && node scripts/test-est-build-library.js && node scripts/test-est-home.js && node scripts/test-est-home-guides.js && node scripts/test-est-ai-ir.js && node scripts/test-est-ai-chat.js
scripts.test:spark: node scripts/test-spark-ai-blocks.js && node scripts/test-spark-runtime.js && node scripts/test-spark-ble.js && node scripts/test-spark-firmware.js && node scripts/test-spark-ai-assistant.js
scripts.test:new-ai: node scripts/test-new-ai-runtime.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-download.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-control.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-firmware.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-telemetry.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-assistant.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-connection-preferences.js && node scripts/test-new-ai-ble.js
